title: feat: add Claude Fable 5.1
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds canonical-only `anthropic/claude-fable-5.1` alongside unchanged Fable 5, routed to Bedrock `global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1`.
- Enables text/image input, tools with automatic choice, adaptive reasoning, 1M context, 128K output, and prompt caching.
- Sets paid-only access and 1x pricing: $10/M input, $50/M output, $12.50/M cache write, and $0.25/M cache read. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/overview
- Documents the 512-token cache minimum and forced-tool-choice 400 behavior. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/whats-new-fable-5-1
- E2E request `0647cac3-bc0e-4533-9465-0a10c1696be9`: HTTP 200 via Bedrock, 28 input + 15 output tokens, exact $0.00103 local wallet debit, and one billed staging Tinybird row on `v1:meter:pack` with matching model, provider, usage, cost, and price.

gist.headline: A fable joins the hive
gist.blurb: Claude Fable 5.1 has landed through Bedrock, with a very large context window and room for both images and careful thinking. Polli put out 1M tiny chairs for the tokens.
gist.summary: Added paid-only canonical model anthropic/claude-fable-5.1 via Bedrock global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1, with text and image input, automatic tool choice, adaptive reasoning, prompt caching, 1M context, and 128K output.
gist.impact: Developers can now call Claude Fable 5.1 through the unified API at 1x pricing, including $10/M input and $50/M output, while using long-context, multimodal, tool, reasoning, and cache workflows.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy library-garden built around a huge open storybook representing Claude Fable 5.1 and its 1M-token context. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, tends flowering code-vines growing from the book while a small CRT monitor robot organizes image cards and tool icons; subtle cache jars and a long glowing parchment convey prompt caching and large output capacity.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light-blue wings, and tiny librarian glasses, tending code-flowers growing from an enormous open storybook in a warm garden-library; a friendly CRT monitor robot stacks image cards, tool symbols, and small glowing cache jars beside a long scroll. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text: "FABLE 5.1".
